prompt:
Tum ek WhatsApp group chat ke liye chhote, natural Hinglish messages likh rahe ho (Roman script).
Group members (sender ke roop mein sirf yehi naam use karo): Divya didi, Tanuja didi, Sunil C., Sunil bhai.
Topic: roz ki baatein, paise ka lena-dena, milna-julna. Kabhi kisi record, entry ya transaction ko delete
ya hatane ka zikr mat karo. Koi ank (digit), rakam, tareekh, din ya mahine ka naam, web address,
bank/app/company ka asli naam, aur bhejna/pay/transfer jaise nirdesh bhi mat likho.
Neeche har hisse ke liye utne hi messages do jitne bole gaye hain, time ke order mein:
- between 7:15 pm and 8:08 pm: 12 messages
- between 8:08 pm and 9:15 pm: 13 messages
Sirf ek JSON list do, koi aur text nahi: [{"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "NAAM", "text": "message"}, ...]
Har "time" "h:mm am" ya "h:mm pm" format mein ho. Har message ek hi line ka ho.
text:
[
  {"time": "7:16 pm", "sender": "Divya didi", "text": "Haan ji sab log kaise hain?"},
  {"time": "7:20 pm", "sender": "Tanuja didi", "text": "Bas badhiya didi, aap batao."},
  {"time": "7:24 pm", "sender": "Sunil C.", "text": "Shaam ki chai ho gayi sabki?"},
  {"time": "7:29 pm", "sender": "Sunil bhai", "text": "Haan bhai, abhi bas baith rahe hain."},
  {"time": "7:33 pm", "sender": "Divya didi", "text": "Vaisa hume aapas ka hisaab dekhna tha na."},
  {"time": "7:38 pm", "sender": "Tanuja didi", "text": "Haan wo purana wala hisaab baki hai abhi."},
  {"time": "7:42 pm", "sender": "Sunil C.", "text": "Main dekh leta hoon jo bhi baki hai."},
  {"time": "7:48 pm", "sender": "Sunil bhai", "text": "Koi jaldi nahi hai bhai, aaram se dekh lo."},
  {"time": "7:52 pm", "sender": "Divya didi", "text": "Milkar baat kar lenge toh zyada accha rahega."},
  {"time": "7:57 pm", "sender": "Tanuja didi", "text": "Sahi kaha, saath mein chai bhi ho jayegi."},
  {"time": "8:02 pm", "sender": "Sunil C.", "text": "Bilkul, ghar par hi milte hain phir."},
  {"time": "8:06 pm", "sender": "Sunil bhai", "text": "Chalo ye sahi rahega."},
  {"time": "8:11 pm", "sender": "Divya didi", "text": "Waise khane ka kya plan hai sabka?"},
  {"time": "8:16 pm", "sender": "Tanuja didi", "text": "Ghar par hi halka khana ban raha hai."},
  {"time": "8:21 pm", "sender": "Sunil C.", "text": "Main bahar hoon abhi thodi der mein aata hoon."},
  {"time": "8:25 pm", "sender": "Sunil bhai", "text": "Aate waqt kuch meetha lete aana."},
  {"time": "8:30 pm", "sender": "Sunil C.", "text": "Thik hai bhai, le aaunga."},
  {"time": "8:36 pm", "sender": "Divya didi", "text": "Aur hisaab kitab ki diary kis ke paas hai?"},
  {"time": "8:40 pm", "sender": "Tanuja didi", "text": "Mere paas rakhi hui hai diary."},
  {"time": "8:45 pm", "sender": "Sunil bhai", "text": "Sab kuch likha hua hai usme pehle se."},
  {"time": "8:50 pm", "sender": "Divya didi", "text": "Accha hai, phir sab samajh aa jayega."},
  {"time": "8:56 pm", "sender": "Sunil C.", "text": "Haan koi tension wali baat nahi hai."},
  {"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "Tanuja didi", "text": "Main sab tayyar rakhungi jab milenge."},
  {"time": "9:08 pm", "sender": "Sunil bhai", "text": "Sahi hai, phir waise hi karte hain."},
  {"time": "9:14 pm", "sender": "Divya didi", "text": "Thik hai phir, baad mein milte hain sab."}
]
